# Breathing Autostart for Nanit

> A free Mac and Windows app that starts Nanit Breathing Motion monitoring when your baby is put down in Breathing Wear and stops it after. Open source.

## App

- [Breathing Autostart for Nanit: Monitoring That Starts Itself](https://jackwallner.com/breathing-autostart/index.html.md): A free Mac and Windows app that starts Nanit Breathing Motion monitoring when your baby is put down in Breathing Wear and stops it after. Open source.
